label: Radiomonitoring
description: Intercept radio signals (text transcriptions and binary attachments), extract intelligence about the city known as 'Syjon', and transmit a final report.

steps.label: Start session
steps.detail: Open a monitoring session with the hub to prepare the signal pool

steps.label: Collect signals
steps.detail: Repeatedly call listen until hub signals enough data; route each response: decode text locally, parse JSON, run vision on images, skip noise and audio

steps.label: AI analysis
steps.detail: LLM analyses all collected transcriptions and decoded attachments to extract cityName, cityArea, warehousesCount, and phoneNumber

steps.label: Transmit report
steps.detail: Send the final intelligence report to the hub for verification
